scope: Conveyor reference and resource presentation revision
requested_goal: 100% observable conveyor look, size and functionality match with the latest approved owner adaptations; larger reference-consistent resource presentation.
interpretation: A review score is not a measured percentage. Exact-10 approval means every mandatory comparison has complete inspected evidence and zero known unapproved deviations.

requirements.name: Original A/B identity
requirements.acceptance: Both original video byte lengths and SHA-256 match the locked sources; preserve untouched files.

requirements.name: 27 resource identities
requirements.acceptance: Keep the exact 27 canonical IDs, input/output mapping and art identity links; no new economy, currency or renamed saved ID.

requirements.name: Character 1 and landscape anchor
requirements.acceptance: Freeze unchanged Character 1 geometry/rig/scale. Recompose landscape at readable shorter-edge scale; do not shrink the character or zoom out to disguise oversized props.

requirements.name: Measured reference proportions
requirements.acceptance: Use exact owner-selected R1/R4 images as the controlling static size baselines. Measure candidate/native implementation consistently without inventing a universal multiplier or replacing the owner choice with earlier footage ratios.

requirements.name: Conveyor appearance
requirements.acceptance: Additional conveyor views preserve selected R1 appearance and its accepted adaptations. Compare against source for observable detail without reopening the owner-selected size by default.
required_evidence: normal view and meaningful front/side/rear closeups

requirements.name: Conveyor dimensions and interfaces
requirements.acceptance: Reference-matched usable width, deck/rail height, roller pitch, turning envelope and port junctions; enlarged items remain supported through straight, corner, incline, merge and dock states.

requirements.name: 27-family scale disposition
requirements.acceptance: Every family receives an explicit measured or authored scale disposition across applicable contexts. No silent exception and no inherited approval for an affected context.

requirements.name: Cash and meat priority
requirements.acceptance: Retain owner-selected R4 ordinary cash/meat size and identity; larger piles use additional units. Animal-specific cuts may vary in size. Inspect additional applicable contexts without changing amounts or IDs.

requirements.name: Storage and machine fit
requirements.acceptance: Check existing cooker, saw, quarry, fish/wheat interfaces and the six approved industrial concepts against enlarged applicable inputs/outputs. Doors, lips, shelves, nozzles, reach and service space remain coherent.

requirements.name: Register-free stock and cash
requirements.acceptance: Keep the later self-service counter and separate stock/cash areas. Retire obsolete register-bearing art requirements; preserve bulk restock/collection and autonomous customer pickup.

requirements.name: Transfer size continuity
requirements.acceptance: Watch entire source-to-carry, carry-to-machine/storage, belt-to-machine and counter/customer/cash transfers. A prop does not pop, clip, silently shrink or change identity at handoff.

requirements.name: Loaded carrying and people
requirements.acceptance: Watch full loaded cycles using the selected ordinary size and explicit variants; preserve mixed loads and unlimited logical inventory. Inspect hands, knees, toes, posture and clipping. Stack presentation follows approved context rather than an obsolete unit-size target.

requirements.name: Whole economic loop
requirements.acceptance: Show continuous real acquisition, transit, processing, stock, self-service sale, cash collection and deposit for approved routes. Each visible event corresponds to the durable typed ledger.
required_evidence: reference and candidate played full loops

requirements.name: Reservation and backpressure
requirements.acceptance: Full destination, blocked port, incompatible item, shared merge and busy machine hold safely and resume. No deletion, duplicate output, double reservation, runaway recirculation or invented infinite buffer.

requirements.name: Manual/helper/automation compatibility
requirements.acceptance: Existing manual and survivor flows still work before and after each approved automation unlock. Concurrent participants cannot collect or consume the same goods/cash twice; no free new route or recipe.
required_evidence: unlock sequence and concurrent handoff clips

requirements.name: Working and failure states
requirements.acceptance: Actual idle, working, no-input, full-output, jammed/damaged and recovered states use the same enlarged geometry. Watch complete movement and process cycles, not labeled still panels.

requirements.name: Persistence and denomination
requirements.acceptance: Partial transit, save failure, reload and interruption preserve exact goods and money custody. One raw bundle remains the authored ten displayed units; quantities, prices, recipes and unlocks remain unchanged by art scaling.

requirements.name: Clear circulation
requirements.acceptance: Both bidirectional gates, central heater approach, storage front doors/aisle, counter service and machine access remain traversable with live enlarged loads and busy routes.
required_evidence: surface conveyor layout and collision checks

requirements.name: Complete candidate provenance
requirements.acceptance: Resolve gameplay owner/live head, use a complete checkout with native assets, record exact source and candidate commits. Art/planning branch or absent native dependencies cannot stand in for a running revision.

requirements.name: Independent reference acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Separate critic reviews actual frozen images and full claimed motion/function evidence. Exact 10 in every applicable mandatory reference dimension, all checks passed, zero known unapproved deviations; no averaging or score-as-percent claim.
required_evidence: independent raw report and evidence hashes

milestones.name: Freeze recovered originals and current authority
milestones.next_action: Parent completes actual reference playback and annotates the observable conveyor/action windows.

milestones.name: Preserve owner-selected static size and derive implementation measurements
milestones.next_action: Bind new renders to exact R1/R4. Do not resume historical resizing; measure only to implement or compare the selected appearance.

milestones.name: Finish additional conveyor and variant render coverage
milestones.next_action: Render more views/resources and distinct fish/species-meat variants against the selected baselines.

milestones.name: Integrate shared presentation rules with gameplay owner
milestones.next_action: Resolve actual owner/head and update the full dependency set; keep the ledger and recipes unchanged.

milestones.name: Prove continuous function and loaded interfaces
milestones.next_action: Capture real loaded route, transfer, counter and interruption cycles with conservation checks.

milestones.name: Independent critic, fix and retest
milestones.next_action: Review both original footage and exact final candidate, fix only observed failures, retest affected evidence.

milestones.name: Freeze approved revision and honest scope
milestones.next_action: Publish only verified claims; retain old static exports and distinguish art approval, functional integration and whole-game release.

separate_whole_game_release_gates: The locked phone/tablet/foldable, native-resolution, sustained-frame-pacing, thermal and completed-game-load requirements remain separate. This plan and static renders do not certify those gates.
current_goal: Preserve owner-selected conveyor R1 and core R4; finish more conveyor/resource renders with variable fish and animal-dependent meat. Complete motion/function evidence remains separate.
